steps.title: See today's trust verdict at a glance
steps.narration: Every page now opens with one simple answer: is today's board safe to rely on? A thin green strip right under the header tells you at a glance, sitting alongside the familiar 'Ready' badge you already know.
steps.point_out: The new green strip reading "GO — today's board is current." just below the header.

steps.title: The same verdict follows you to Stocks
steps.narration: Head over to the Stocks leaderboard and the identical green strip is right there too, so you never wonder whether this page's data is trustworthy before you scroll further.
steps.point_out: The same GO strip sits above the ranked leaderboard, with every stock's evidence badge still fully visible beneath it.

steps.title: Drill into a single stock — still covered
steps.narration: Open a single stock, like NVDA, and the same trust verdict sits right above its scores and evidence badge.
steps.point_out: The GO strip above NVDA's Leadership, Entry Quality, and Risk scores.

steps.title: Your watchlist carries the same guarantee
steps.narration: Your saved watchlist gets the identical strip, so a personal shortlist is covered exactly like every other page.
steps.point_out: The GO strip above the watchlist table.

steps.title: Even the evidence ledger is covered
steps.narration: The Evidence page, where every claim's real track record lives, shows the same banner too — so you know the ledger itself is trustworthy before you read it.
steps.point_out: The GO strip above the certified-claims ledger table.

steps.title: The verdict reaches the research tools too
steps.narration: It's not just the main pages — Research and its labs inherit the exact same banner, because it's built once into the shared shell instead of being bolted onto each page separately.
steps.point_out: The identical GO strip above the Research lab list.

steps.title: ...all the way into a specific lab
steps.narration: One level deeper, in the Factor Lab, the banner is still exactly the same strip with exactly the same words — one verdict, everywhere, always.
steps.point_out: The same GO strip above the Factor Lab table.

steps.title: No collisions, even on busier pages
steps.narration: Even on the Data Manager page, which already has its own status panels, the new strip sits cleanly on its own line without overlapping anything. And on a bad day, this same strip turns amber or red with a plain-English reason — though today, everything checks out green.
steps.point_out: The thin GO strip sitting above Data Manager's own coverage panels, clearly separate from them.
